facts.heading: Decided to get a divorce
facts.content: Jana and her husband decided to get a divorce after 15 years of marriage. Jana still cannot understand it.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, my husband and I decided to get a divorce. And I still can't understand it.

facts.heading: Divorce not approved
facts.content: The government in Croatia had not yet approved the divorce. In September, they told Jana it was not going any further.
facts.evidence: In September they told me that it was not going any further.

facts.heading: Feelings during divorce
facts.content: Jana experienced emptiness and anger several times a day during the divorce process.
facts.evidence: Emptiness. Then anger. Then emptiness again. It was several times a day.

facts.heading: Regret about blindness
facts.content: Jana thinks she should have seen things and feels she was blind. She keeps looking for mistakes.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I was blind. I keep thinking about it and I keep looking for mistakes.

facts.heading: Reason for feeling tired
facts.content: Jana thinks she was too tired and not interested in the issues. She also thinks she got too old.
facts.evidence: I think I was too tired and I wasn't interested in them. Only that I got too old.

facts.heading: Difficulty telling children
facts.content: Jana has two children, Anšce and Matěj, who are 8 years old. She does not know how to tell them about the divorce.
facts.evidence: I have two kids, Anšce and Matěj. They're 8 years old. I don't know how to tell them.

facts.heading: Anšce's suspicion
facts.content: Anšce is getting more suspicious about the situation.
facts.evidence: Anička is getting a bit more suspicious.

facts.heading: Anšce's question about dating
facts.content: Last week Anšce asked Jana if they were dating, and Jana said no.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were dating. I said no.

facts.heading: Anšce's feelings about lying
facts.content: Jana felt terrible because Anšce lied and knew it. Jana saw this in Anšce's eyes.
facts.evidence: I felt terrible. Because she lied to me. And she knew it. I saw it in her eyes.

facts.heading: What Anšce lied about
facts.content: Anšce lied to Jana about destroying her life and taking her home.
facts.evidence: That I destroy her life. That I take her home.

facts.heading: Fear of telling the truth
facts.content: Jana is afraid of Anšce's tears if she tells her the truth.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Matěj's understanding
facts.content: Matěj is still small and does not understand much about the situation.
facts.evidence: Matěj is still small, he doesn't understand much.

facts.heading: Jana's desire for a real life
facts.content: Jana prefers to feel like a real person, especially regarding living in a mortgage.
facts.evidence: Living in a mortgage, I'd rather feel like a real person, at least I feel.

facts.heading: Editor solved money issues
facts.content: The editor always solved the money problems for Jana.
facts.evidence: The editor always solved the money.

facts.heading: Jana's current job
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno. She teaches 9th and 8th grade.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno. I teach 9th and 8th grade.

facts.heading: Jana's current activity
facts.content: Jana walks around with a rabbit in her hand when studying.
facts.evidence: I walk around with a rabbit in my hand.

facts.heading: Feels life is falling apart
facts.content: Jana has a feeling that everyone sees her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I have a feeling that everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Principal was informed
facts.content: Jana told the principal about her crying on the court.
facts.evidence: I told her that because I once cried on the court.

facts.heading: Principal offered time off
facts.content: The principal let Jana leave earlier and gave her an hour off.
facts.evidence: she let me leave earlier, gave me an hour off.

facts.heading: Feeling worse at home
facts.content: Jana felt worse after the principal let her leave.
facts.evidence: Only then I sat at home and it was worse.

facts.heading: Alone at work was better
facts.content: Jana felt better when she was alone at work and had something to do.
facts.evidence: Because I was alone at work, I had at least something to do.

facts.heading: Sleep problems at night
facts.content: Jana sleeps badly and wakes up at 3 am to think about what is next.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3 am and I think about what's next.

facts.heading: Thoughts upon waking
facts.content: Jana thinks about her lack of mortgage, wife, and possessions when she wakes up.
facts.evidence: I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a wife, I have nothing.

facts.heading: Sleep schedule is irregular
facts.content: Jana sleeps around 5 and wakes up at 6.30 in the morning.
facts.evidence: I sleep around 5 and wake up at 6.30.

facts.heading: Weight loss occurred
facts.content: Jana moved a little and lost 4 kilos.
facts.evidence: I move a little. I lost 4 kilos.

facts.heading: Friend comments on appearance
facts.content: A friend tells Jana she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: My friend tells me I look terrible.

facts.heading: Sister Alen is supportive
facts.content: Jana has a sister named Alen in Olmouc who calls her almost every evening.
facts.evidence: I have sister Alen in Olmouc. She calls me almost every evening.

facts.heading: Fear of lying to sister
facts.content: Jana is afraid her sister will think she lied to her.
facts.evidence: That I lied to her.

facts.heading: Fear of being a bad example
facts.content: Jana is afraid her sister thinks she is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Mother's comment on marriage
facts.content: Jana's mother said marriage is held and it is up to the individual.
facts.evidence: She always said that marriage is held and it's up to you.

facts.heading: Mother's reaction to Jana
facts.content: When Jana told her about her situation, her mother was moaning.
facts.evidence: She was moaning.

facts.heading: Mother's subsequent contact
facts.content: The mother has not called Jana much since the conversation.
facts.evidence: She hasn't called me much since then.

facts.heading: Jana feels sad
facts.content: Jana feels sad and wishes her mother would hug her.
facts.evidence: Sad. I would need her to hug me.

facts.heading: Jana's desire to express feelings
facts.content: Jana wants to tell her mother that it hurts and she does not want to be alone.
facts.evidence: That it hurts, that I don't want to be alone, but that it doesn't happen here.

facts.heading: Jana's current coping strategy
facts.content: Jana is crying and apologizes for speaking her feelings out loud.
facts.evidence: I'm crying, I'm sorry.

facts.heading: Therapist's suggestion for help
facts.content: Jana asked what could help her most, and the therapist suggested sleep and her presence.
facts.evidence: Sleep. And you, Jede, who is there with you.

facts.heading: Tried herbivore tea
facts.content: Jana has tried herbivore tea for sleep.
facts.evidence: Herbivore tea, that's all.

facts.heading: Avoids medication due to fear
facts.content: Jana does not want pills because she is afraid she will become addicted.
facts.evidence: I don't want to be addicted.

facts.heading: Jana considered writing
facts.content: Jana considered using a small cup and paper to write what would wake her up. Jana stated she could get it out of her head.
facts.evidence: I could, but at least I'll get it out of my head.

facts.heading: Jana expressed fears
facts.content: Jana expressed fears about panicking, crying, and not staying calm. Jana also considered being a coward.
facts.evidence: That I panic and cry, that I can't stay calm. That I'd be a coward?

facts.heading: Jana felt scared
facts.content: Jana stated that being a coward would be scary for her.
facts.evidence: That would be scary for me.

facts.heading: Jana considered feeling allowed
facts.content: Jana considered seeing that she is allowed.
facts.evidence: Or you could see that I'm so allowed.

facts.heading: Jana did not think of idea
facts.content: Jana stated she did not think of the idea mentioned.
facts.evidence: I didn't think of that.

facts.heading: Jana focused on not being alone
facts.content: Jana focused on the idea that she is not alone. Jana also focused on not having to do things right away.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone and that I don't have to do it right away.
